name: data-lakehouse
description: ADLS Gen2 bronze/silver/gold zones, Data Factory with a managed VNet, a secure Databricks workspace, and Key Vault.
what: An ADLS Gen2 account (hierarchical namespace, shared-key access disabled) with bronze, silver, and gold containers; an Azure Data Factory with a managed virtual network and AutoResolve integration runtime for private ingestion and orchestration; a premium Databricks workspace with secure cluster connectivity (no public IP) for transformation; and a Key Vault for secrets. Data Factory holds a managed identity with Blob Data Contributor on the lake.
why: Analytics platforms standardize on the medallion pattern to progressively refine data from raw to curated. This template lays down the storage zones, a private orchestration plane, and a governed compute engine so data teams start from a secure, well-structured foundation instead of ad-hoc storage and notebooks.
potentialUseCases: Enterprise data platform feeding BI and ML
Batch + incremental ingestion from operational systems into a lake
Regulatory reporting datasets curated through gold tables
Feature engineering and model training on Databricks

reliability: Managed integration runtime auto-resolves region and scale
security: Shared-key access disabled; Data Factory uses managed identity
ADF managed VNet keeps ingestion off the public data plane
Databricks secure cluster connectivity (no public IP) in prod
costOptimization: Standard Databricks tier and single-LRS lake in dev
Serverless / job clusters scale Databricks compute to workload
operationalExcellence: Data Factory diagnostics streamed to Log Analytics
Zoned containers make lineage and lifecycle policies explicit
performanceEfficiency: Hierarchical namespace optimizes analytics file operations
Databricks Photon / job clusters tune compute to the stage

cost.profile: Prod profile: ZRS lake, premium Databricks, managed-VNet Data Factory.

components.name: Databricks (premium) DBUs
components.notes: Assumes ~2000 DBUs/month; VM compute billed separately.

components.name: Data Factory managed VNet IR (data flow)
components.notes: Assumes ~200 vCore-hours of managed-VNet data movement.
